spirit_breaker_bull_rush.name: Empowering Haste
spirit_breaker_bull_rush.description: Spirit Breaker gains bonus Movement Speed for a duration whenever he stuns an enemy. Effects from multiple stuns stack and have independent durations. Duration pauses during Charge of Darkness.
spirit_breaker_bull_rush.note0: Empowering Haste buff allows Spirit Breaker to go over the max movement speed limit.

spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.name: Charge of Darkness
spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.lore: Barathrum erupts from the darkness with unwieldy force.
spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.description:
Spirit Breaker fixes his sight on an enemy unit and starts charging through all objects, starting at %min_movespeed_bonus_pct%%% of the bonus speed and reaching his max speed after %windup_time%s.

All enemy units passed through and the targeted unit will be hit by a Greater Bash.  If the targeted unit dies, Spirit Breaker will change his target to the nearest enemy unit to that location.
spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.facet_spirit_breaker_bull_rush: Charge of Darkness bonus movement speed lingers after charge ends.
spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.note0: Spirit Breaker passes through trees, cliffs, and units.
spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.note1: The charge indicator is visible only to allies.
spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.note2: Spirit Breaker gains shared vision of the target.
spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.shard_description: Increases Charge of Darkness Bonus Speed by %bonus_movement_speed%.
spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.abilitydraft_note: No other units will be hit by Greater Bash if it's not drafted as well. Target of Charge of Darkness will be stunned on impact even without Greater Bash.

spirit_breaker_bulldoze.name: Bulldoze
spirit_breaker_bulldoze.description: Spirit Breaker gains movement speed and status resistance to ram through enemies. Can be used while charging.
spirit_breaker_bulldoze.lore: Barathrum warps the fabric of reality around him, lessening its influence on his physical form.

spirit_breaker_greater_bash.name: Greater Bash
spirit_breaker_greater_bash.lore: The signature strike of Barathrum's ghostly ball and chain.
spirit_breaker_greater_bash.description: Gives a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack. Deals a percentage of movement speed as damage.
spirit_breaker_greater_bash.facet_spirit_breaker_bulls_hit: Greater Bash chance is increased if you've bashed more than one hero within the last %bonus_chance_duration%s. Each additional hero past the first increases Greater Bash chance by %bonus_chance_pct%%%.
spirit_breaker_greater_bash.note0: Does not stack with Skull Basher.
spirit_breaker_greater_bash.note1: Break disables the passive percent Chance to Bash. Does not disable Greater Bash application from Charge of Darkness or Nether Strike.
spirit_breaker_greater_bash.abilitydraft_note: In Ability Draft, does stack with Skull Basher.
spirit_breaker_greater_bash.scepter_description: Increases knockback. If a knocked-back enemy collides with another enemy, the second enemy is bashed (creeps only receive %cascading_bashes_creep_penalty%%% damage), and the original target takes %cascading_bashes_damage_multiplier%%% of Greater Bash's damage again.

spirit_breaker_nether_strike.name: Nether Strike
spirit_breaker_nether_strike.lore: Barathrum temporarily returns to the realm from where he came, bringing with him the retribution of both worlds.
spirit_breaker_nether_strike.description: Spirit Breaker slips into the nether realm, reappearing next to his hapless victim. Upon reappearing, a Greater Bash of the current level occurs and deals bonus damage. Knocks back for double the normal distance.
spirit_breaker_nether_strike.facet_spirit_breaker_imbalanced: Enemy targets hit by Nether Strike will be moved further by allied knockback effects.
spirit_breaker_nether_strike.note0: Spirit Breaker appears behind the target to deliver the bash.
spirit_breaker_nether_strike.abilitydraft_note: Greater Bash must be drafted for stun.  Bonus damage still applies without Greater Bash.
